result: Compilation succeeded. I wrote `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/ClassUtilsAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering `ClassUtils`'s documented contract: constants, `comparator`, class/name conversions (including `ClassCastException` paths), `getAbbreviatedName` (including the javadoc's example table and `IllegalArgumentException` boundary), interface/superclass hierarchy traversal order, all `getClass`/`getClassStrict` overloads (array syntax, inner-class syntax, whitespace-normalization vs. strict behavior, `NullPointerException`/`ClassNotFoundException`), `getComponentType`, the various `getName`/`getPackageName`/`getPackageCanonicalName`/`getShortClassName`/`getShortCanonicalName`/`getSimpleName` overloads with their literal javadoc examples, `hierarchy` with/without interfaces, `isAssignable` (primitive widening, autoboxing on/off, array overloads), `isInnerClass`, `isPrimitiveOrWrapper`/`isPrimitiveWrapper`, `isPublic`, wrapper/primitive array conversions, `toClass`, and the deprecated public constructor — using only Java 8-compatible syntax (no diamond operator, lambdas, or unnecessary try-with-resources).
